Despite booking and paying in advance for a table and a bowling alley, we faced constant pushing and overcrowding (dhakka-mukki) throughout the evening. I raised the issue multiple times in advance with both the lady and male bouncers, yet every complaint was ignored.

To make matters worse, a man wearing a sleeveless vest (sando) — clearly allowed by this “sando-only club of Mumbai” — used extremely abusive and vulgar language, including offensive remarks involving mothers. What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Anushka Bose
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Board Game Tavern hosted by the wonderful Suneet and Srushti was hands down my best decision to spend a Saturday evening! Walked into a room full of strangers, but by the end it all felt like family. The vibe was so warm, welcoming and full of energy.

The game rounds were insanely fun I mean by the second round I honestly wanted to pull my hair out because we just couldn’t find the demon 😭 (in the best way possible). It was intense, hilarious and addictive all at once.

Such a unique experience with amazing hosts and an even better crowd. (Already can’t wait for the next game night!) Highly recommend this to anyone looking for something different and super fun to do in the city.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Your review has us smiling from ear to ear 😃. 
We're stoked to know that you had a good time with us as did we!

And we'd love for you to experience all the events that we have in store for you. Dungeons & Dragons, Boardgames, party games, etc. 

Our BGT family is ever so welcoming of those who are entering this crazy fun world of gaming and we absolutely love that ❤️. Glad you could experience it.

We're SO HAPPY to know that BGT sounds like your idea of a perfect weekend ✨.

Until next time Isha 😇

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Kumar Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to the Boardgame Tavern for a Dungeons & Dragons session just to understand the game… and walked out completely hooked. Suneet our Dungeon Master didn’t just run the game, he turned it into a real-life movie. Every scene felt immersive, every choice mattered, and the storytelling was top-tier.

You’ll come here for the games and get addicted to the cookies. 🤭

Special shoutout to Srushti, not just for the absolutely addictive cookies, but also for hand-painting the character minis for the game. That level of effort and creativity added so much soul to the experience.

Overall, an awesome place to come, make friends, and truly enjoy the games.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you so much Abhishek for such a beautiful feedback ✨.

Your journey which has just begun is awaiting many more adventures with us 🧭. Be it D&D, BOTC or any of our other sessions, we'd love to have you over for them all 😊. 

See you soon!

featured_reviews.name: Nandini Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Boardgame Tavern is run by two wonderful hosts who are building a beautiful community of people who love board games, social games, role playing games and much more. While you start off saying you’ll spend only 4 hours there, time flies when you start playing these super fun and engaging games. BGT is not just another game cafe, it is a community building bonds, a homely vibe, a time of pure enjoyment and screen free joy. Highly recommended if you want to spend a fun filed weekend alone or with friends.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Nandini,

Your review has us smiling from ear to ear ❤️. Thank you for sharing such a warm feedback. You truly understand the essence of BGT and what we aim to bring to our lovely family members. It's both a pleasure and an honour to have you at our events and see you participate with such enthusiasm. 

You'll forever be remembered as our chivalrous Paladin 🗡️ 🫡

Love,
Team BGT ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Mangesh Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was recently introduced to The Boardgame Tavern by a friend as a fun weekend activity, and I walked in with absolutely zero knowledge of board games or social deduction games like Blood on the Clocktower. My very first experience at BGT was playing BOTC, and honestly, it was incredible.

Even though I was playing alongside experienced players, the hosts, Suneet and Srushti, made the entire experience feel effortless and welcoming. They explained everything so well that I never felt out of place or overwhelmed. What could have been intimidating turned into a thoroughly enjoyable and engaging session. Since then, I genuinely look forward to attending BOTC games at the Tavern.

The hosts do a fantastic job of creating a fun, inclusive, and comfortable atmosphere for everyone, regardless of experience level. After my first BOTC session, I have gone on to attend several more BOTC games, other social games, and even a Level One D&D session, each of which has been equally enjoyable.

The Boardgame Tavern is truly a special place, and every visit leaves me excited for the next one. I am always looking forward to attending more BGT events and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great social gaming experience.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Folks like you make our sessions EVEN more special. 
From a shy first timer to now a regular at the Tavern😊, our family is happily thriving and growing with the presence of members like yourself. Truly appreciate your kind words and the love and respect you've shown us ♥️

Watching you experience different sessions has been nothing short of pure joy. And we can't wait for you to make more such incredible memories with us ✨

See you soon Mangesh 👋🏽

featured_reviews.name: Mounica Gotluru
featured_reviews.review_text: Very cool place for boardgames! Had attended D&D session. Really taken efforts for you to be included in the game and have fun. Plus the hosts are really fun and interactive. The sound effects during the game gave an altogether a different vibe and experience. Definitely give it a try!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for such lovely words Mounica! 

We're glad that we could introduce you to this mystical world of Dungeons and Dragons. 
For someone who's relatively new to gaming, you played your part so well and aced at it too. 

Can't wait to see you level up with our level 2 D&D adventure ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Aryaman Patwardhan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Boardgame Tavern has quickly become my favorite weekend spot. I’m here almost every Saturday and it always feels like home. Whether it’s diving into a Dungeons & Dragons one-shot (kudos to the effort both of the hosts take to make it a memorable adventure), or unraveling the identity of the imp in Blood on the Clocktower, or laughing through lighthearted social games like Psychiatrist, there’s always the perfect mix of fun and community.

Adding to the charm are the Tavern’s two adorable cats, who wander around making sure everyone knows whose turf it is. And every week, the host treats us with the most phenomenal homemade chocolate chip cookies, honestly worth the trip just for those!

If you’re looking for a cozy, welcoming place to play games, make friends, and share snacks, I can’t recommend the Board Game Tavern enough.

Oh and P.S. the occasional potluck’s!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Aryaman,

We're through the moon after reading your feedback. I mean, it's one thing to host but having people fall in love with the community, the events, cookies and the cats surely tops it all ❤️. We hope to be your weekend getaway for all the future weekends to come. 

Here's to many more game nights, countless D&D adventures and loads of BOTC shenanigans. 

Can't wait to see you again ✨

Besides gaming, I loved their freshly baked cookies and befriending the resident cats.

Thank you for such sweet words from us and the fur babies 🐱❤️🐱
